review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Supply Engineering Team Lead based in Brazil. This fully remote leadership opportunity is ideal for an experienced procurement and supply chain professional ready to shape and scale an international supply engineering function. You will lead a team of four Supply Engineers, driving operational efficiency, supplier performance, and continuous process improvement. Reporting directly to the Chief Technical Officer, you will play a central role in coordinating procurement activities across complex custom glass and architectural projects. The position combines team leadership and cross-functional collaboration with hands-on technical procurement support when needed. You will manage supplier relationships across the United States, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia, ensuring materials meet project specifications and production schedules. This is an opportunity to influence operational strategy, build scalable processes, and contribute directly to business growth in an international environment. Accountabilities Procurement Operations: Oversee procurement activities to ensure production teams have the glass, hardware, and materials required to meet project schedules. Coordinate orders, inventory planning, and procurement forecasts. Technical Procurement and Documentation: Review technical drawings and project specifications to prepare accurate material lists. Verify dimensions, finishes, and quality requirements, and ensure procurement documentation and component orders are completed ahead of production and container arrivals. Supplier Management: Identify, evaluate, and develop relationships with suppliers across the United States, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia. Negotiate pricing, payment terms, and delivery schedules while monitoring supplier performance. Purchasing and Supply Chain Coordination: Manage purchasing activities supporting production, warehouse, and installation operations. Resolve supplier-related quality, logistics, and delivery issues, and identify opportunities to reduce costs and improve procurement efficiency. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Sales, Project Management, Engineering, Estimating, Warehouse, and Installation teams to coordinate material requirements, engineering changes, substitutions, and procurement planning. Team Leadership and Development: Lead, mentor, and develop a team of four Supply Engineers. Allocate responsibilities, prioritize workloads, monitor deadlines, and provide regular coaching, feedback, and performance guidance. Quality Control and Escalation: Review the team's procurement documentation, material lists, and purchase orders. Support engineers with complex sourcing challenges and manage supplier escalations when necessary. Process Improvement and Reporting: Build and optimize procurement workflows, standards, and operating procedures. Coordinate activities across departments and report progress, operational risks, and performance updates to the Chief Technical Officer. Hands-On Engineering Support: Provide direct procurement and sourcing support during peak workloads, employee absences, or particularly complex projects. Requirements At least 3 years of experience in procurement, sourcing, or supply chain management within the glass, glazing systems, architectural hardware, or a closely related industry. At least 3 years of people management experience, preferably leading procurement, sourcing, or supply teams. Demonstrated experience building or scaling a procurement or sourcing function, including establishing processes, workflows, supplier management standards, reporting, KPIs, and team structures. Strong knowledge of the full purchasing cycle, with experience designing and implementing procurement policies, procedures, and operational processes. Proven experience working with international suppliers and markets, ideally across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia. Hands-on sourcing and procurement experience involving glass, glazing components, aluminum or steel systems, architectural hardware, fittings, accessories, or similar construction materials. Previous professional experience working with the US market is essential, including direct procurement or sourcing experience with US-based suppliers and international markets. Strong supplier relationship management and negotiation skills, including experience handling pricing, payment terms, lead times, quality concerns, and supply risks. Knowledge of international logistics, import/export procedures, customs, and cross-border procurement. Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, engineering documentation, and project specifications. Experience implementing or improving procurement tools, task management systems, reporting processes, and cross-functional workflows. Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and PDF tools. Fluent English is required; fluent Russian is considered an advantage. Strong leadership, communication, organizational, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment. Proactive problem-solving abilities, sound decision-making, and a high level of ownership and accountability. Benefits Competitive salary based on experience. Fully remote work arrangement. Paid time off, including: 5 paid vacation days during the first year. 15 paid vacation days annually from the second year onward. 5 paid sick leave days per year. 32 hours of protected time off annually. review_candidates.title: DevOps Engineer
review_candidates.description: Why Pythian At Pythian, we are experts in strategic database and analytics services, driving digital transformation and operational excellence. Pythian, a multinational company, was founded in 1997 and started by ensuring the reliability and performance of mission-critical databases. We quickly earned a reputation for solving tough data challenges. We were there when the industry moved from on-premises to cloud environments, and as enterprises sought more from their data, we expanded our competencies to include advanced analytics. Today, we empower organizations to embrace transformation and leverage advanced technologies, including AI, to stay competitive. We deliver innovative solutions that meet each client’s data goals and have built strong partnerships with Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, SAP, and Snowflake. The powerful combination of our extensive expertise in data and cloud and our ability to keep on top of the latest bleeding edge technologies make us the perfect partner to help mid and large-sized businesses transform to stay ahead in today’s rapidly changing digital economy. Why You This role sits on one of the largest database estates in the world, supporting one of our biggest clients — the kind of scale most infrastructure engineers never get direct access to. Changes made here don't touch one system, they touch a fleet, so the impact of good (and bad) engineering is outsized. We're looking for an infrastructure/DevOps engineer to own the AWS platform our clients' RDS and Aurora databases run on — not the databases' internals. You'll manage the Terraform and CI/CD pipeline (GitLab, Harness) that provisions them, maintain the supporting tooling that handles user and schema management, and be the escalation point when a team's Terraform, pipeline, or process has gone wrong. A big part of the job is making that go wrong less often: improving documentation, and building out the tooling that automatically routes support queries to the right place instead of everything landing on-call. If this is you, and you wonder what it would be like to work at Pythian, reach out to us and find out! Intrigued to see what a life is like at Pythian? Check out #pythianlife on LinkedIn and follow @loveyourdata on Instagram! Not the right job for you? Check out what other great jobs Pythian has open around the world! Pythian Careers Support & Troubleshooting What you will be doing: Act as the escalation point when clients or internal teams break their Terraform, break their pipeline, or don't follow documented process — diagnose the actual problem and get them unblocked. Write clear Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reports for significant incidents. Infrastructure & Automation Build and maintain Terraform for provisioning AWS database infrastructure (RDS/Aurora), and the GitLab/Harness pipelines that deploy it. Maintain the supporting tooling that manages database users and schemas, ensuring it stays correctly integrated with the databases it manages. Automate recurring operational work with Python or Go. Apply AWS security best practices — IAM roles, KMS encryption, Security Groups, Network ACLs — across managed environments. Enablement & Tooling Build and improve the incident-response tooling so support queries get automatically routed to the right place, rather than landing on the person who is on call. Own and improve documentation — runbooks, operational guides, disaster recovery procedures — so people stop making the same mistakes. What We Need From You 5+ Years of experience with AWS and Terraform in a production environment Provisioning AWS infrastructure through a CI/CD pipeline (GitLab, Github, Harness, or equivalent). Familiarity with RDS/Aurora operations — backup/restore, replication, disaster recovery — at the infrastructure level Solid understanding of AWS security and compliance controls. Experience automating operational tasks with Python or Go. Proficiency in AWS networking (VPC, Subnets, Transit Gateways). Comfortable being the person people come to when infrastructure or a pipeline is broken — clear communication under pressure, no hand-holding needed to trace a symptom to its root cause. Nice to have: Docker, Vault, ProxySQL, and general relational database familiarity (MySQL or similar). What You Will Receive Love your career: Competitive total rewards package. Blog during work hours; take a day off and volunteer for your favorite charity. Love your work/life balance: Flexibly work remotely from your home, there’s no daily travel requirement to an office! All you need is a stable internet connection. Love your coworkers: Collaborate with some of the best and brightest in the industry! Love your development: Hone your skills or learn new ones with our substantial training allowance; participate in professional development days, attend training, become certified, whatever you like! Love your workspace: We give you all the equipment you need to work from home including a laptop with your choice of OS, and an annual budget to personalize your work environment! Love yourself: Pythian cares about the health and well-being of our team. You will have an annual wellness budget to make yourself a priority (use it on gym memberships, massages, fitness and more). Additionally, you will receive a generous amount of paid vacation and sick days, as well as a day off to volunteer for your favorite charity. Hiring Disclaimer The successful applicant will need to fulfill the requirements necessary to obtain a background check. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in any aspect of the selection process. AI Disclaimer Pythian may utilize Enterprise Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools or features throughout its hiring process. These tools help us manage high volumes of applications efficiently and may be employed to review applications, analyze resumes, and assist with other recruitment steps. While Pythian uses AI in its hiring process, it does not substitute for human judgment. Our Talent Acquisition Team reviews all AI-generated recommendations, and the system is subject to regular bias audits to ensure fairness and compliance with all applicable employment and human rights laws. All final hiring decisions are made by, and remain the responsibility of, human decision-makers. By applying for this position, you consent to Pythian’s use of these AI tools in the evaluation of your application. You have the right to request a human review of any solely AI-driven decision or to request an accommodation. Should you require further details regarding the processing of your data, please reach out to us.

review_candidates.title: 项目控制经理
review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 岗位职责： 1. 项目控制体系建设：建立健全项目计划、进度、成本、风险、变更及报告等全过程控制体系，制定项目控制计划及相关制度流程。 2. 进度管理：编制和更新项目总体进度计划（一级、二级计划），监督各专业计划执行情况，定期分析实际进度与计划差异并提出纠偏措施。 3. 成本控制：负责项目预算编制与动态监控，跟踪合同付款、变更订单及现金流，确保项目成本在预算范围内可控。 4. 风险与变更管理：识别并评估项目风险，制定应对预案；管理变更控制流程，评估变更对成本和进度的影响。 5. 报告编制与业主沟通：负责编制项目进度月报、成本报告、风险报告等各类控制报告，定期向业主、管理层及利益相关者汇报项目状态，并就关键问题与业主进行沟通协调。 6. 业主对接：作为项目控制维度与业主的主要联络人，参与业主例会、专题会，回应业主对进度、成本的关切，确保业主满意度和信息透明。 7. 合同与分包控制：参与合同谈判与评审，审核承包商付款申请及变更报价，监督分包商的计划与成本执行情况。 8. 数据与工具管理：使用Primavera P6、MS Project等计划工具进行进度管理，运用Power BI、Excel等工具进行数据分析与可视化呈现。 9. 团队管理：领导项目控制团队，分配工作任务，指导下属开展工作，提升团队专业能力。 10. 其他工作：完成项目经理交办的其他控制相关工作。 任职资格： 1. 学历专业：本科及以上学历，工程管理、土木工程、化工工程、机械工程或相关专业。 2. 外企工作背景：具备外资工程公司或跨国公司项目控制岗位工作经验，熟悉外企工作流程、项目管理体系及国际工程惯例。 3. 工作经验：8年以上工程项目控制相关工作经验，其中至少3年以上项目控制经理岗位经验。 4. 语言能力：流利的英语听说读写能力，能够独立撰写英文项目报告，与外籍业主及管理方进行无障碍沟通。 5. 专业技能： 精通Primavera P6、MS Project等进度管理工具； 熟悉成本控制、挣值管理（EVM）、风险分析等方法论； 具备较强的数据分析与报告编制能力。 6. 沟通协调：出色的沟通表达能力，能够有效与业主、设计、施工、监理等多方协调沟通。 7. 领导能力：具备团队领导力、抗压能力和问题解决能力，能够推动项目控制目标实现。 8. 其他要求：能适应项目现场工作，接受阶段性出差。 9. 加分项：持有PMP、CCP、PSP或RMP等专业认证者优先；有化工、石化或新能源行业项目控制经验者优先。
